title: Pure Tenyi
summary: Pure Tenyi Wyrm strategy focused on self-summoning spirit dragons that activate from the hand and graveyard while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster, omitting outside Swordsoul or Baronne packages. Using Monk of the Tenyi and Berserker of the Tenyi as effectless anchors, the deck triggers banish effects to bounce cards, extend from the Deck, and build unyielding boards.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tenyi Spirit - Ashuna Special Summons itself from hand while you control no Effect Monsters, and banishes itself from hand or GY to Special Summon any Tenyi monster from your Deck while you control a non-Effect Monster.

Tenyi Spirit - Vishuda Special Summons itself from hand while you control no Effect Monsters, and banishes itself from hand or GY to return 1 card your opponent controls to the hand while you control a non-Effect Monster.

Tenyi Spirit - Adhara Special Summons itself from hand as a Level 1 Tuner while you control no Effect Monsters, and banishes itself from hand or GY to add 1 of your banished Wyrm monsters to your hand.
Vessel for the Dragon Cycle sends 1 Wyrm monster from your Deck to the GY, and if you control a non-Effect Monster, also searches a Tenyi monster with a different name from your Deck.

Tenyinfinity Field Spell searches Vessel for the Dragon Cycle or Heavenly Dragon Circle on activation, tributes a Wyrm to destroy an opponent's monster, and can transform into Flawless Perfection of the Tenyi.

summary.title: Opening: Ashuna + Adhara
steps: Special Summon Tenyi Spirit - Ashuna from your hand while controlling no Effect Monsters.
Link Summon Monk of the Tenyi using Ashuna to establish an effectless non-Effect Monster on your field.
Banish Ashuna from your GY to Special Summon Tenyi Spirit - Adhara from your Deck.
Activate Tenyinfinity to search Vessel for the Dragon Cycle, then use Vessel to mill Tenyi Spirit - Vishuda and search Tenyi Spirit - Suruya.
Synchro Summon Tenyi Spirit - Mula Adhara or Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, triggering Suruya to cheat out Berserker of the Tenyi from your Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Tenyi Spirit - Mula Adhara adds a Field Spell from Deck to hand on Synchro Summon, and cannot be targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects while you control a non-Effect Monster.
Draco Berserker of the Tenyi banishes an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect when it activates its effect, and gains ATK when destroying an Effect Monster.

Draco Masters of the Tenyi is a Link-3 that cannot be destroyed by battle with an Effect Monster, and destroys Effect Monsters your opponent controls up to the number of non-Effect Monsters you control.

Tenyi Spirit - Sahasrara Link-4 prevents the opponent from targeting Effect Monsters for attacks or effects while you control a non-Effect Monster, and targets an opponent's monster to spawn a Tenyi Spirit Token copying that monster's original ATK.
Shaman of the Tenyi discards 1 card to Special Summon a Wyrm monster from your GY, and destroys 1 card your opponent controls when an attack is declared involving your non-Effect Monster.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Flawless Perfection of the Tenyi makes all non-Effect Monsters on the field completely unaffected by monster effects, and draws 2 cards whenever your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster.

Fists of the Unrivaled Tenyi Counter Trap negates the activation of a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect while you control a face-up non-Effect Monster, and if destroyed while Set by an opponent's effect, Special Summons a non-Effect Monster from your Extra Deck.
Heavenly Dragon Circle tributes a Wyrm monster to search a Wyrm from Deck, or Special Summons it if a non-Effect Monster was tributed, and banishes from GY to search a Tenyi card.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Swordsoul engines and Forbidden cards like Baronne de Fleur are omitted to keep the list purely focused on Tenyi non-Effect synergy.
